visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a dramatic comparison of thinning hair on a scalp, using stark lighting to emphasize hair loss, accompanied by bold variety-style text overlays. (2) A young woman with long brown hair and professional makeup speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor setting with neutral walls. (3) In a bathroom, she points to her hair roots while looking into a mirror, followed by high-definition close-ups of 'Health-Daily' shampoo and conditioner bottles placed on a shelf. (4) Graphic overlays appear featuring portraits of TCM doctors in white coats and a digital image of a US patent certificate to build brand authority. (5) The woman demonstrates the shampoo, pouring a clear liquid onto her hand and then massaging a dense white foam into her hair while wearing a brown top. (6) Technical diagrams show hair follicles and herbal ingredients like ginseng and tea tree, followed by shots of her walking in a sunny hallway tossing her hair. (7) She is seen in the shower applying conditioner to the ends of her hair and then rinsing it, showing the water flow over her dark, wet hair. (8) An outdoor shot features the woman from behind, walking in a park-like setting with sunlight reflecting off her exceptionally shiny and long hair. (9) Back indoors, she uses a spray bottle to apply scalp tonic to her hairline, massaging it gently with her fingers. (10) The video concludes with the woman gesturing towards the camera with a smile, encouraging viewer interaction as text prompts appear on screen.
